about.description:
I am a Software Engineer with over 6 years of experience engineering native Android applications and modern web solutions. My technical expertise centers on native Android development with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, alongside modern web technologies including Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

Throughout my work across fintech, e-commerce, and digital health platforms, as well as maintaining open-source tools in the Frogo ecosystem, I focus on clean architecture, modular codebases, and maintainable software design. I am committed to solving complex technical challenges and building scalable, high-quality products that deliver lasting impact.
